# The Great Repurpose

> Reclaiming agency, meaning, and value in the age of AI. The Great Repurpose names the identity crisis underneath AI workforce disruption and offers a path through it: five stages, ten Repurpose Profiles, and two organizational programs — the Executive Leadership Academy and the TGR Transition Academy.

The Great Repurpose is a movement and a set of programs for people and organizations whose work and identity are being reshaped by AI. Individuals take a free 7-question assessment to find their Repurpose Profile. Organizations engage TGR Academy: leadership training for executives making AI-era workforce decisions, and transition support for employees whose roles have ended.

Founded by Kyle Shannon. Site: https://thegreatrepurpose.com/

## The five stages

1. Unhook Identity — separate who you are from the title you held.
2. Reclaim Value — name the value you actually create, independent of a role.
3. Find Your Purpose — aim that value at something worth building.
4. Discover AI's Power — develop real, practical AI agency, not another upskilling checklist.
5. Start Creating — ship work into the world; the relaunch.

## For organizations (TGR Academy)

- [TGR Academy](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/academy): Overview of both programs, who they are for, and how to engage.
- [Executive Leadership Academy](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/academy/leadership): For CEOs, COOs, CHROs, heads of talent, and workforce transformation leads. An eight-hour immersive workshop plus ninety-minute implementation sessions every two weeks for three months, applied to the real workforce, technology, and organizational decisions already on the table. Four parts: understand the implications of AI, shift your leadership mindset, build executive AI readiness, and find and support your people before defaulting to headcount cuts. Premise: 95% of GenAI pilots show no measurable impact — the gap is leadership, not technology.
- [TGR Transition Academy](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/academy/transition): Outplacement reimagined for an AI-shaped future. For HR and people teams supporting departing employees. Traditional outplacement polishes resumes for jobs that are disappearing; the Transition Academy moves a cohort through the five stages together — unhooking identity, reclaiming value, and building AI agency to relaunch. Runs standalone or layered onto an existing outplacement vendor. Premise: 70% of the skills used in most jobs will change by 2030.

## For individuals

- [Repurpose Profile assessment](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/selfcheck): Free 7-question, 2-minute self check that scores you across the five stages.
- [The 10 Repurpose Profiles](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/types): Identity Seekers (The Unlocker, The Awakener, The Explorer), Direction Finders (The Firestarter, The Translator, The Original), Builders in Motion (The Compass, The Architect, The Catalyst), and The Amplifier.
- [The Five Stages](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/phases): Detailed breakdown of each stage and what the work looks like there.
